piancai_day_branch.defline: The Horizon lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life always has an opening in it.
piancai_day_branch.reading: You want a home life with somewhere to go in it, and you are drawn to people whose world is wider than yours. Because your openings come through the people closest to you, love and opportunity arrive together for you more often than for most. Your home years open wider than any before them, and you share them with a person whose world is bigger than your own.

Love.headline: You fall for people who widen your life.
Love.recognition: In love you fall for people who widen your life, the one with plans and friends and somewhere to be. Because range is what draws you, you lose interest within months in a partner who only offers closeness. What you want is someone who brings the world home, and you grow restless with anyone who shuts it out.
Love.lived: The people you have fallen for so far each came with a world attached, a circle of friends or a plan to move or a family that took you in. More than once you have stayed a little longer for the life around someone than for the person.
Love.ahead: Your Home Chapter opens in your mid-thirties, and it is when love and money start to move together. You build a home in these years with someone who brings an opening into your life, and you stay for as long as the two of you keep heading somewhere together.

Social.headline: Your friends come with plans.
Social.recognition: You collect friends who are going somewhere, the ones with a trip planned and a contact for everything. Because range is what draws you, you lose touch with friends whose lives stay small, and you feel guilty about it only later. You know a great many people, and you let only a few of them close.
Social.lived: Most of your friendships have started with an introduction or an invitation, someone who brought you into their circle. You have kept some of those circles longer than you kept the people who brought you in.
Social.ahead: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape your next twenty years through someone you share a home with.

Wealth.headline: Your money comes through the people close to you.
Wealth.recognition: You find money through other people, in a tip from a friend or a side venture with someone close. Because your openings arrive through people you trust, you say yes before you read the terms, and you earn in bursts more than in a steady line. The money you make fastest is the money you hold on to least.
Wealth.lived: Your best money moments so far came through someone else, a tip or a job offer or a deal brought to you by a friend. You lost money the same way, by saying yes before you had read the terms.
Wealth.ahead: From your mid-thirties your income starts to rise through the life you share with a partner, through a joint venture, a move or an opening from their side. You will earn more in these years than in all the years before, and you keep only what has both names written down.

piancai_hour_branch.defline: The Horizon lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years runs a wish to keep moving and keep meeting people.
piancai_hour_branch.reading: In later life you want plans on the calendar and people arriving from far away. Because new places and new company keep you lively, a quiet year weighs on you more than a busy one, and you spend on trips without much counting. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, pick up some of your restlessness as your family gathers in bursts. You count those gatherings as your real wealth, and you pay for most of them yourself.

Family.headline: Your family spreads wide and gathers in bursts.
Family.recognition: You love your family best when everyone is together for a few loud days, and you plan those days months early. Because distance has never felt like loss to you, long gaps between visits pass without worry. You give the people close to you many short visits and few long stays.
Family.lived: Your family has scattered across more than one place since your late forties, and the younger ones live far from you and from each other. You have become the one who brings them together, and your best days in those years have been reunions.
Family.ahead: From your late forties the people after you settle in different places and keep you travelling to see them. You become the reason they meet, and you find the gatherings worth more to you than anything you could buy them.

Wealth.headline: Your later money keeps moving, and so do you.
Wealth.recognition: You keep money in motion, in a late venture or a trip or help for someone younger with a plan. Because an untouched account feels wasted to you, you spend on movement and company before you think of reserves. Your savings grow slowly because so much of your money is always on its way somewhere.
Wealth.lived: Your money since your late forties has gone into travel, new projects and the plans of younger people more than into reserves. You have earned well from at least one late venture, and you have spent a good part of it on getting people together.
Wealth.ahead: Chances to earn keep reaching you from your late forties, through younger people or through a move. Your money stays lively in these years, and you sleep best when one part of it never moves.

piancai_hour_stem.defline: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures.
piancai_hour_stem.reading: In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.

Wealth.headline: Your money finds new openings late in life.
Wealth.recognition: You notice a chance to earn where others see an ending, a late venture or a deal offered by someone younger. Because new money excites you more than kept money, you give generously and write down too little of it. Your plans live in your head far longer than they live on paper.
Wealth.lived: Money has reached you through new ventures and unexpected offers since your late forties, at least once from a direction you had stopped watching. You have given a good share of it away, more than once without noting to whom.
Wealth.ahead: From your late forties chances to earn keep arriving, through new projects and through people a generation younger who want you involved. You give a great deal in these years, and your affairs stay clear only where you have put the details in writing.

Growth.headline: You keep starting new things when others stop.
Growth.recognition: You grow by entering fields you know nothing about, at an age when most people stick to what they know. Because being a beginner keeps you awake and curious, a life that only repeats itself bores you within months. You surprise the people around you with how many times you begin again.
Growth.lived: You have taken up at least one new subject since your late forties, a skill or a trade or a kind of work nobody expected from you. Younger company has kept you learning in those years, and you have looked less settled than people your age.
Growth.ahead: Your learning goes on in public from your late forties, through new work and through friendships with people much younger than you. You grow more curious with each decade, and you are the one in your family with the newest stories.

piancai_month_branch.defline: The Horizon lives inside your Month Gate: under your working years runs a quiet sense of where value is about to move.
piancai_month_branch.reading: You sense where prices and people and fashions are heading before most of the people around you, and you build your work on that instinct. Because you trust it more than any plan, you earn in waves, with strong seasons followed by flat ones. Each good run makes you want a bigger one, and the gains go back into the next chance. You keep most in the years when someone patient holds what you bring in.

Career.headline: Your work pays for reading where things are going.
Career.recognition: You are drawn to work where timing matters, buying and selling or finding things before others notice them. Because you read change early, a job where nothing moves bores you, and you leave it sooner than you planned. In any role you end up as the person who sees what is coming next.
Career.lived: The jobs that have gone best for you since your late teens are the ones where you could spot a trend early, in sales or trading or finding the right people. More than once you have left a steady job because it gave your instinct nothing to do.

Wealth.headline: Your money comes in strong seasons and quiet ones.
Wealth.recognition: You earn in bursts, a run of good months and a quiet stretch after. Because each good season makes you sure of the next, you spend the winnings on a new chance before you have kept any. You are richer in the middle of each lucky stretch than after it.
Wealth.lived: What you have earned since your late teens has followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. At least once you have lost the gains of a good year by chasing a better one, and you have learned how your own luck runs.

piancai_month_stem.defline: The Horizon stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the one who spots the opening first.
piancai_month_stem.reading: You find work and money through people, the tip and the contact and the good timing. Because chances reach you that way, you spend your working years meeting people, and your circle and your income grow together. Money comes in through friends and movement, and it leaves the same way, through gifts and plans that drift. You are richest in the years when some of each windfall stays put.

Career.headline: You are paid for spotting the chance others miss.
Career.recognition: You do your best work wherever there is something to find, a client or a deal or a gap in the market. Because the search keeps you sharp, a fixed salary and a quiet desk wear you down faster than hard work. You are the colleague people come to first when they need a way in.
Career.lived: Your best career moves since your late teens have come through timing, a job heard about early or an offer made in a casual conversation. You have changed direction more than once because a better chance turned up.

Wealth.headline: Your money arrives in windfalls and leaves through friends.
Wealth.recognition: You earn best from timing, a bonus or a sale or a deal that comes good all at once. Because you trust the next chance to arrive, you spend and lend freely between windfalls. Your money leaves as easily as it arrives, and you notice only when a quiet season comes.
Wealth.lived: Good years and thin ones have followed each other since your late teens, with money arriving in lumps and leaving through generosity. More than once you have spent a windfall on friends and new plans before you set a share of it aside.

Social.headline: You know someone for every need.
Social.recognition: You collect contacts the way other people collect friends, and you love introducing people who should meet. Because your network brings you work and money, the useful friendships and the warm ones get mixed together. You have lost a real friend at least once by treating them as a contact.
Social.lived: Many of your friendships since your late teens began over work, a deal or a shared plan. You have kept in touch with more people than anyone you know, and a few of them have become close for life.

piancai_year_branch.defline: The Horizon lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your settled surface sits a pull toward somewhere else, carried down your family.
piancai_year_branch.reading: Someone in your family left home to look for something better, and you grew up hearing about it. Because moving was part of how your family got by, you feel most alive in unfamiliar places and most at rest when you come back. Your best chances with money come from far off, and you have always needed a fixed home to return to.

Family.headline: Your family holds together across distance.
Family.recognition: You keep close ties with relatives who live far away, and you are the one who calls first. Because distance was ordinary when you were growing up, a long absence never feels to you like a break in love. You are the link between relatives who would otherwise lose touch.
Family.lived: In your first home people spoke of a relative who had moved away, or you moved yourself and made friends quickly in each new place. By the time you were grown your family stretched across more than one place, and you felt at home in each of them.

Wealth.headline: Your luck with money improves the further you go.
Wealth.recognition: You find your best chances away from home, in a new city or an unfamiliar market or among strangers. Because familiar places feel small to you, you look outward for money before you look nearby. You earn far from home and feel safe only once the money is back in one place.
Wealth.lived: Money in your family came through moving when you were young, a relative working away or a business that travelled. The first money you made yourself came from beyond your own neighbourhood, and you liked how that felt.

piancai_year_stem.defline: The Horizon stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home spent openly on people and on chances.
piancai_year_stem.reading: You grew up in a family that spent on guests, gifts and new plans, and everyone who visited could see it. Because money moved freely in the house you grew up in, you learned to spot a chance quickly and to hold cash loosely. That ease with risk has served you well, and you still give faster than you keep.

Wealth.headline: You learned early that money is for moving.
Wealth.recognition: You spend on people and chances easily, and a good opening excites you more than a full account. Because money in your first home came and went in plain sight, you feel calm with risks that frighten more careful people. A store kept apart from your generosity is the thing you find hardest to build, and you know it.
Wealth.lived: As a child you watched money arrive in good months and go out on visitors and fresh ideas. By your teens you had a quick eye for a chance, and saving was something you had to teach yourself.

Family.headline: Your family taught you generosity, and its price.
Family.recognition: You give freely in your family, the treat paid for and the loan made without terms. Because an older relative showed you that generosity makes people love you, you find it hard to refuse anyone close. You keep giving after you can afford to, and you resent it only later.
Family.lived: An older relative in your first home, a parent or someone who stood in for one, spent widely and drew people around them. Growing up you learned both the warmth of that generosity and what it cost the household.

zhengcai_day_branch.defline: The Steward lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: your private life is built on steady, practical care.
zhengcai_day_branch.reading: You love by providing, with the bills paid and food in the house on ordinary days. Because steadiness is how you feel safe, you want a partner who values upkeep as much as you do. The cost comes when care turns into chores and the warmth goes quiet. The people you love come to rely on the calm home you keep, and you are proudest of that.

Love.headline: You love someone by looking after them.
Love.recognition: You show love through practical care, a meal ready or a problem fixed before your partner mentions it. Because reliability is what made you feel loved, you trust a partner who keeps small promises more than one who makes big ones. You let romance fade when the duties fill every evening.
Love.lived: The partners who have lasted with you so far have been the steady ones, people who turned up on time and kept their word. More than once you have kept a shared home running so well that you noticed the quiet in the romance only afterwards.
Love.ahead: From your mid-thirties your partnership becomes the most reliable thing in your life, built on shared accounts and a home kept well. You find these years warmest when pleasure keeps its place beside the chores, and you notice quickly when it slips.

Family.headline: Your home runs well, and everyone leans on it.
Family.recognition: You keep your household running, the cupboards full and the bills paid before they are due. Because a well kept home is how you show love, you feel uneasy when things at home are left undone. Your family feels safe without knowing how much you do, and you rarely tell them.
Family.lived: In every home you have shared, you have been the one who knows where the spare keys and the papers are. Your family and friends have turned to your household in hard weeks, and you have made space for them each time.
Family.ahead: Your home becomes the steady point for your whole family from your mid-thirties, the place relatives come to when life is hard. You give these years to keeping it well, and the order you keep outlasts every crisis that passes through.

zhengcai_hour_branch.defline: The Steward lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years sits a quiet habit of keeping everything provided for.
zhengcai_hour_branch.reading: In later life you want things settled, with savings kept, care arranged and nothing left to chance. Because providing is how you love, you make arrangements for others long before they are needed, and you keep your own sleep and meals in the same good order. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn thrift by watching you. Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.

Family.headline: Your family rests on what you quietly arrange.
Family.recognition: You look after your family through arrangements, the bills covered and the plans made for whoever needs them. Because care for you means provision, you say almost nothing about what you have arranged. Your family sees the comfort and rarely the work behind it, and you prefer it that way.
Family.lived: You have been the one keeping your family covered since your late forties, with help ready before anyone asks. You have taught the younger people in your family to be careful with money, mostly by example.
Family.ahead: From your late forties the people after you rest on the provision you have made. You become the steady one in your family, and you learn in these years to say some of your care out loud.

Health.headline: Your body does best on steady upkeep.
Health.recognition: Your body gets the same care as your accounts, with regular walks, sensible meals and early nights. Because routine is what keeps you feeling safe, small daily care suits you better than any sudden effort. You notice the first sign of tiredness, and you deal with it early.
Health.lived: Your energy has held steady since your late forties because you kept your sleep and your meals in order. You have kept more of it than people who pushed hard and rested little.
Health.ahead: Your body repays the care you keep giving it from your late forties, with steady energy and good sleep. You stay strong in these years, and you feel the benefit of every ordinary habit.

Wealth.headline: Your money ends up settled and secure.
Wealth.recognition: You keep reserves for every possible need, and a full account calms you more than any purchase. Because security is what you work for, you spend on others easily and on yourself with reluctance. You have more comfort available than you let yourself use.
Wealth.lived: Your finances have settled since your late forties, and your household has felt the hard times around it less than most. You have spent more on others than on your own comfort in that time.
Wealth.ahead: Your money stays steady from your late forties while others worry, and your plans for it land where you intend. You find in these years that some of what you saved is meant for your own pleasure, and you learn to use it.

zhengcai_hour_stem.defline: The Steward stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: your later life is ordered and well provided for.
zhengcai_hour_stem.reading: In later life you pay your own way, even when the middle years scatter your plans. Because keeping things in order is how you show care, the habits you hold turn into calm accounts and settled debts after your late forties. You teach the people after you about money mostly by example, and you leave your family more than numbers.

Wealth.headline: Your money gets steadier every decade.
Wealth.recognition: You plan for the long run even when the present is messy, and a small regular saving pleases you more than a big win. Because security matters more to you than excitement, you judge a year by what you kept rather than what you earned. You are building something slowly, and you know it.
Wealth.lived: Since your late forties your accounts have settled, the debts cleared and the savings finally visible. You became the one in your family with enough, and you have quietly paid for more than you mention.
Wealth.ahead: Your late forties are when years of steady saving finally show. Debts close and the accounts settle, and you become the one in your family who has enough.

Family.headline: You end up as the one who provides.
Family.recognition: You show love for the people who rely on you by making sure they are covered. Because provision is how you say what matters, you are more comfortable paying for something than talking about it. You want everyone who comes after you to be safe, and you plan for it years early.
Family.lived: You have become your family's provider since your late forties, the one who covers the gaps and makes the arrangements. You have said more with money than with words, and some of it has gone unheard.
Family.ahead: From your late forties your family leans on what you have built, and you give it calmly. You become the relative everyone trusts with arrangements, and you will find yourself saying out loud some of what your money already says.

zhengcai_month_branch.defline: The Steward lives inside your Month Gate: your working years rest on steady effort and money you have plainly earned.
zhengcai_month_branch.reading: You want to build something that lasts, a skill kept up and savings that grow each year. Because you trust only what you have earned yourself, you turn down quick gains that would ask you to become someone else. Your progress at work looks slow at first and surprises people later. The cost is a tight grip, and you take less pleasure in what you have built than it could give you.

Career.headline: Your career grows slowly and keeps growing.
Career.recognition: You do your best work in a job you can stay in and get better at, with clear tasks and fair pay. Because you value what you can explain and defend, you distrust shortcuts and the people who take them. You are underrated in the early years of any role, and you outlast most of the people who underrated you.
Career.lived: Your working life has moved forward one step at a time since your late teens, with each job adding a skill you kept. More than once you have overtaken people who started faster than you.

Wealth.headline: Your savings grow quietly, year after year.
Wealth.recognition: You save a part of everything you earn, and a steady rise in your accounts pleases you more than any windfall. Because security is what you are working for, you avoid risks that would make you rich quickly. Your caution keeps you safe, and you feel a good year as relief more than as joy.
Wealth.lived: Even in lean months you have put money aside since your late teens, and your savings have grown more than people expected. You have turned down at least one exciting offer because it asked too much risk.

zhengcai_month_stem.defline: The Steward stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work you are known as the one trusted with the money.
zhengcai_month_stem.reading: You are handed the budget, the accounts and the jobs that need order in every place you work. Because being relied on is how you prove your worth, you take on other people's messes and sort them without fuss. Your income rises on a steady schedule, and your standing rises with it. You are needed everywhere at work, and you are thanked less than you are used.

Career.headline: You are the one trusted with the books.
Career.recognition: You are given charge of money and order wherever you work, and things run better near your desk. Because reliability is what you offer, you accept extra tasks without asking for more pay or a promotion. You carry more of the work than your title shows, and your colleagues lean on it.
Career.lived: You have been given responsibility early in every job since your late teens, a budget or a set of keys or a team's accounts. Your promotions have come steadily, each one a little later than your work deserved.

Wealth.headline: Your money arrives on time and keeps arriving.
Wealth.recognition: You earn a regular income and build on it month by month, with raises won through steady work. Because predictability makes you feel safe, you distrust any money that comes too easily. Your wealth grows in a straight line, and you prefer it that way.
Wealth.lived: The money you have counted on since your late teens is the salary, raised a step at a time and planned for well in advance. You have kept to your own plan while friends chased quick gains, and you have rarely regretted it.

zhengcai_year_branch.defline: The Steward lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your first years lay a careful home where nothing was wasted.
zhengcai_year_branch.reading: You took in your family's habits with money before you could name them, and they still shape how you feel about spending. Because thrift felt like safety when you were small, you save quietly and early, and your money grows in ways other people mistake for luck. Your relatives remain the people you turn to first, and they turn to you. Under the calm sits a small worry about running short, and you carry it even in good years.

Family.headline: Your family pays back what it is given, and so do you.
Family.recognition: You rely on your family more than on friends, because help between you has come back each time it was needed. Since your first home kept careful accounts, you keep track of what is owed between relatives without saying so. You give help readily, and you feel uneasy until a debt is settled.
Family.lived: As a child you knew that money at home was handled carefully and that nothing was spent without a reason. Early on you counted your own money and kept your word the way the household did.

Wealth.headline: Your money grows quietly from early habits.
Wealth.recognition: You save without thinking about it, a little from everything, and spending without a reason feels wrong to you. Because careful habits were normal in your first home, you build wealth slowly and steadily, and few people notice until it is large. You enjoy keeping money more than spending it, and a big purchase stays on your mind for weeks.
Wealth.lived: You kept coins and small earnings longer than your friends did as a child, and nobody had to tell you to. You learned early that money kept quietly was money that stayed, and you have never lost the habit.

zhengcai_year_stem.defline: The Steward stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: your first home ran on care, counting and things kept.
zhengcai_year_stem.reading: You grew up where money was spoken about plainly and spent with a plan, and that order was the first thing people saw in your family. Because care with money reached you as safety, you still feel calm when the accounts are in order and uneasy when they are not. You still run every budget on the habits you formed before sixteen, and they are why your savings grow when others stall.

Wealth.headline: You learned the value of money early.
Wealth.recognition: You spend with a list and save before anyone asks you to, and money that sits unplanned makes you uneasy. Because order around money felt like safety from your first years, you lose more sleep over a careless purchase than it ever cost you. You are slower to enjoy what you have than to keep it.
Wealth.lived: You learned what things cost before most children do. Money at home was counted and spent with care, and by your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

Family.headline: You were raised in a careful, orderly home.
Family.recognition: You show love in your family by keeping things in order, the bills paid and the arrangements made. Because care at home looked like provision when you were small, you trust a relative who plans more than one who says warm things. You are the one your family calls when something needs organising, and you rarely say no.
Family.lived: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and promises kept, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.
